content.short: Business banking, cards, treasury, invoicing and payments.
content.description: Slash is a business banking platform, backed by Y Combinator, that combines accounts, corporate cards, treasury, invoicing, and stablecoin payments for companies operating globally. Businesses can hold and manage funds, issue physical and virtual cards, run payments and payouts, and move money using both traditional rails and stablecoins such as USDC over networks like Ethereum and Solana. Slash targets founders and finance teams — including those in crypto-native and internationally distributed businesses — that want fast onboarding, programmable spend controls, and the ability to bridge fiat and stablecoin flows in one place. By blending everyday business banking and cards with stablecoin payments and treasury, Slash positions itself as a modern financial hub for companies that operate across borders and across both traditional and on-chain money.
